subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as append?: boolean on the existing write tool, and if so should maintainers land this broader branch or the narrower overlapping PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40001?
rationale: The need for an append primitive is well supported, but the permanent model-facing API shape and which active branch should carry it are maintainer product/API decisions rather than an automated repair choice.

options.title: Accept append flag and choose one branch
options.body: Approve append?: boolean as the contract, land the branch maintainers prefer after exact-head CI/review, and close the other open append PR as duplicate.

options.title: Request a different write API
options.body: Ask the active PR to switch to a string mode or dedicated append tool if maintainers do not want a boolean on write.

options.title: Defer broader file-protection work
options.body: Keep both append PRs unmerged only if maintainers want to solve this with a larger file-protection or append-only policy design first.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag and choose one branch
recommendation.body: Approve append?: boolean as the contract, land the branch maintainers prefer after exact-head CI/review, and close the other open append PR as duplicate.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest history-backed owner for the agent tool/API and adjacent session lifecycle boundary decision.
